propositions: Repository delegation must preserve the boundary between local multi-file persistence and selective tickets-branch publication without blurring ownership or partial-state rules.
Selective publication must stage only the five allowlisted bridge-state files; unrelated files and non-allowlisted bridge-state artifacts must not be published.
Repository checkpoints (save/save_retired) must not independently publish; local file changes must remain local unless explicitly staged via reconcile_helpers.py.
Unchanged passes must create no commit; GET rotation and retired-first publication floors must preserve pre-extraction recovery semantics through the delegating facade.

Repository ownership and ordered partial-state behavior, selective publication mechanics, rollback semantics, and explicit no-journal/no-format-migration decisions must be documented in ADR 0099 with architectural rationale and rejected alternatives.
